scenario.summary: Guest, on the PDP opened by the head method: selects the fourth variant of the chain by its attribute values and adds it three times with different personalization texts (three cart lines).
steps: Select variant4's Bulb Size, Color and Technology
Type DisplayText, add to cart, verify cart count
Clear it, type AdditionalInformation, add to cart, verify cart count
Type both, add to cart, verify cart count
stateChanges: Guest cart: three lines of variant4 added; emptied by personalizeAttributeRemoveAllItemsFromCart
assertions: Cart count increases by one after each add
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): personalizeAttributeSearchForConfigurableProduct runs first and declares every record need of the chain (product, variant1, variant2, variant3, variant4); the migrated class keeps the resolved records in class fields and the later methods read them (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when a field is null), so they declare no needs of their own. This method reads variant4 and the pinned attribute codes (class fields). The record values it reads today (variant SKU z-2510011) are declared as sources of personalizeAttributeSearchForConfigurableProduct; until the class is migrated, check-hardcoded reports them here.

Adds three lines: DisplayText text only, AdditionalInformation text only (after clearing DisplayText), both. Codes 'DisplayText'/'AdditionalInformation' and texts 'DeckerVoltCordlessReciprocatingSaw'/'PleaseHandleWithCare' are values the test chooses: config.
Each add checks the cart count with the page object's counter; InitialQuantity '1' is config.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart/quickOrder entries and the Playwright pdp entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays, image extension) are framework constants: role config, no need.
